title: Unbounded proper base change over a torsion coefficient ring
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative torsion ring (equivalently $n\cdot1_\Lambda=0$ for some integer $n\ge1$). Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of schemes, $g:Y'\to Y$ any morphism, $X'=X\times_Y Y'$, and $f':X'\to Y'$, $g':X'\to X$ the projections. Write $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ for the small etale site and $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ for the unbounded derived category of sheaves of modules over the constant coefficient ring, as in [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For every $E\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$, the canonical exchange map of [def-kun-unbounded-exchange]
$$g^{-1}Rf_*E\longrightarrow Rf'_*g'^{-1}E$$
is an isomorphism in $D(Y'_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$.

source.place: Tag 0F0G, lemma-projection-formula-proper-mod-n, proof; Tag 0F0C, lemma-proper-base-change-mod-n, proof with torsion-ring coefficients

proof.text: Use additive torsion at 1_Λ to obtain a positive natural number n with n·1_Λ=0. This is Mathlib IsOfFinAddOrder.exists_nsmul_eq_zero, applied to hΛ(1).
Apply the finite cyclic-coefficient unbounded proper base-change theorem to n and the same cartesian square.

Transfer this cyclic-coefficient exchange isomorphism to Λ at every object K using the annihilator equation. Assemble the componentwise IsIso instances into the natural-transformation isomorphism with NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app.
